videos.topic_es: Semillas con demasiada agua (Moho y ahogamiento)
videos.video_plan_es: Un vecino tiene un problema en su jardín: las plantas se ven marchitas y hay moho. Seedboy llega al rescate y, usando sus herramientas científicas, diagnostica que las semillas se están ahogando por el exceso de agua y la falta de oxígeno, lo que también favorece el moho. Desde el punto de vista de las semillas, estas se quejan humorísticamente de su situación. Seedboy explica la ciencia detrás del problema (falta de aire para las raíces, ambiente para el moho) y ofrece una solución simple: mejorar el drenaje. Finalmente, el jardín se recupera y prospera.
videos.scene_1_prompt_en: 3D Animation, cinematic, vibrant garden scene. A distressed elderly neighbor in gardening gloves points with concern at wilting, moldy plants in a raised garden bed. A determined, heroic Seedboy, adorned with his signature leaf cape and sprout antennae, flies gracefully into frame from the top right, landing gently beside the neighbor with a confident smile. Dynamic camera swoop follows Seedboy's arrival, ending in a medium shot.
videos.scene_2_prompt_en: 3D Animation, macro shot, extreme close-up on Seedboy's gloved hand gently probing the soggy, dark brown soil of the garden bed. A noticeable patch of fuzzy green mold is visible near a struggling, yellowed sprout. Seedboy uses a futuristic, glowing soil moisture sensor, which blinks an alarming red indicator. The camera slowly pushes in on the sensor's critical reading, highlighting the excessive moisture.
videos.scene_3_prompt_en: 3D Animation, extreme close-up, inside the dark, waterlogged soil. Three adorable, anthropomorphic seeds (one round, one bean-shaped, one tiny sprout) float helplessly amidst swirling water bubbles and slimy green mold spores. They look uncomfortable and a bit green, mimicking human expressions of distress. One seed tries to 'swim' futilely. A slow, subtle camera drift emphasizes their cramped, airless confinement.
videos.scene_4_prompt_en: 3D Animation, medium shot, Seedboy kneels beside the garden bed, holding up a transparent cross-section of soil. One side shows 'drowning' seeds, thick mold, and no air pockets. The other side shows healthy roots with ample air spaces. He points to the saturated side, explaining with a kind, educational gesture. Camera subtly zooms out to show the contrast in the soil cross-sections.
videos.scene_5_prompt_en: 3D Animation, dynamic montage sequence, Seedboy gently aerating the soil with a small, child-friendly spade, carefully turning it over to break up clumps. He then adds a handful of coarse sand, blending it into the soil. We see a subtle time-lapse effect as the soil texture visibly transforms from dark, soggy muck to lighter, more aerated earth. Quick cuts emphasize the efficiency and ease of the solution.
videos.scene_6_prompt_en: 3D Animation, epic finale shot, the garden bed now vibrant and lush with healthy, bright green plants reaching cheerfully for the sun. Flowers bloom, and tiny sprouts thrive. The cheerful neighbor waters appropriately with a happy, content smile. Seedboy gives a triumphant thumbs-up and winks at the camera. A crane shot slowly pulls back to reveal the flourishing garden, with Seedboy flying off into the distance, a hero's departure.
videos.voiceover_en:
Neighbor: Oh dear, my garden is so soggy, and look at this mold!
Seedboy: Hmm, let's see! (sensor beeps) Too much water! Seeds need air, but all this dampness lets mold thrive.
Seed 1: It's so wet, I can't breathe!
Seed 2: And this fuzzy stuff tickles!
Seedboy: Proper drainage and less water will help!
Neighbor: Wow, it's growing beautifully now!
videos.post_text_en: 🌱💧 Is your garden looking a bit sad and soggy? Don't let your seeds drown! 😱 Too much water can lead to mold and unhappy plants. Learn how Seedboy saves the day with proper drainage and the right amount of H2O! Watch to find out the secret to a thriving garden! #Seedboy #GardenTips #PlantCare #AIAnimation #GrowSmart #OverwateringSolved #GreenThumb

videos.topic_es: Semillas amontonadas: La lucha por el espacio y los nutrientes.
videos.video_plan_es: Un vecino tiene un jardín con plantas que no prosperan. Seedboy llega para investigar y descubre que el problema es la sobrepoblación de semillas, que compiten por espacio, luz y nutrientes. Las semillas, de forma humorística, se quejan de su situación. Seedboy explica la ciencia detrás de la competencia y demuestra la solución: adelgazar las plántulas para darles espacio. Finalmente, el jardín se recupera y florece.
videos.scene_1_prompt_en: 3D Animation, cinematic wide shot of a vibrant but slightly struggling garden patch. An elderly, worried neighbor character with a watering can sighs, looking at stunted plants. A playful, curious Seedboy character, carrying a small magnifying glass and wearing a green vest, floats into frame from the top-right, landing softly. Camera pans to follow Seedboy as he approaches the neighbor.
videos.scene_2_prompt_en: 3D Animation, extreme macro shot zooming into the base of several small, struggling plant sprouts. Seedboy, with a concerned but determined expression, uses his magnifying glass to inspect the crowded soil, pointing to multiple tiny sprouts emerging from a single spot. The camera slowly zooms out, revealing the tightly packed seedlings. Soft, natural lighting highlights the problem.
videos.scene_3_prompt_en: 3D Animation, a whimsical close-up shot from underground, showing several adorable, animated seed sprouts with tiny, expressive faces. They are squished together, roots intertwined. One seed rolls its eyes, another groans, and a third pushes playfully. 'Hey, move over!', one 'says'. The lighting is dim, reflecting their struggle for light and space.
videos.scene_4_prompt_en: 3D Animation, a cheerful medium shot of Seedboy holding up two cartoon illustrations: one showing overcrowded seeds struggling, the other showing well-spaced seeds thriving with plenty of room. He gestures to the illustrations while explaining simply. The camera gently tracks around him as he makes his point. Neighbor listens attentively, nodding in understanding.
videos.scene_5_prompt_en: 3D Animation, a detailed shot showing Seedboy's tiny hands gently and carefully thinning out some of the overcrowded sprouts, creating more space between the remaining ones. He uses a small, precise tool. The camera uses a low angle, emphasizing the delicate nature of the task. The soil now looks less congested. The neighbor watches with hopeful anticipation.
videos.scene_6_prompt_en: 3D Animation, an uplifting cinematic wide shot of the garden. The formerly stunted plants are now noticeably taller, greener, and vibrant, reaching towards the sun. Butterflies flutter around happily. Seedboy and the happy neighbor stand admiring the flourishing garden, a sense of peaceful accomplishment. The camera slowly cranes up for an inspiring aerial view.
videos.voiceover_en:
Neighbor: Oh, Seedboy! My garden is so crowded, nothing's growing!
Seedboy: Hmm, let's investigate... It seems like everyone's a bit too close for comfort here.
Seed 1: Ugh, get off my root!
Seed 2: I can't even see the sun!
Seedboy: Ah, the problem is overcrowding! Plants need space to grow big and strong. We need to 'thin them out' so each has enough food and light.
Neighbor: Look, they're thriving!
videos.post_text_en: Is your garden feeling a little too cozy? 🌿 Watch Seedboy solve the mystery of overcrowded seeds in this fun 30-second animation! Learn why every plant needs its personal space to grow big and strong. 🌱 It's all about finding the perfect balance! #SeedboyAdventures #GardenScience #OvercrowdingSolution #PlantCare #AnimationContest
